en: Improved SDK liveness during a non-streaming fallback request: with partial messages on, a `ping` stream event is now sent every 30 seconds on the Anthropic API, Claude Platform on AWS and gateways
zh: 改进非流式回退请求期间 SDK 的存活检测：开启部分消息后，在 Anthropic API、Claude Platform on AWS 和网关上现在每 30 秒发送一次 `ping` 流事件
